production.note: US model years 2017 to 2025. First: PCNA's U.S. press information: "With the 2017 718 Cayman, Porsche is introducing the third generation of the mid-engine sports coupe." Last: kbb-2025-718-cayman lists a 2025 "S" trim with 350 hp and says "production of the 718 Boxster and 718 Cayman is set to end October 2025"; Kelley Blue Book shows no 2026 model year (kbb-2026-718-cayman). No opened Porsche page states that 2025 was the last US model year.

body.note: Porsche calls the car a "mid-engine sports coupe". The open car is sold under its own name (718 Boxster).

configuration.note: "Type Turbocharged flat four-cylinder engine"; "No. of cylinders 4"

displacementL.note: 2,497 cc. Quote: "Displacement 1,988 cm3 2,497 cm3" (718 Cayman | 718 Cayman S).

fuel.note: Inferred from the press information's description of a turbocharged flat-four with no hybrid system.

transmission.note: "Six-speed manual transmission with single-disc clutch and dual-mass flywheel; optional seven-speed Doppelkupplungsgetriebe (PDK)". DCT is Porsche PDK.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Max. power output 300 hp 350 hp at engine speed 6,500 rpm" (718 Cayman | 718 Cayman S). Still 350 hp for 2025 per kbb-2025-718-cayman ("350 horsepower and 309 lb-ft of torque").

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 6-speed manual. Porsche labels it "Unladen weight per DIN" (DIN, without driver). Quote: "Unladen weight per DIN 2,944/3,010 pounds 2,988/3,054 pounds" (718 Cayman | 718 Cayman S; figures are Manual/PDK). PDK is 3,054 lb. Same figures on PCNA's 718 Cayman spec sheet pcna-718-cayman-us-specs: "Unladen weight 2944 / 3010 lbs. 2988 / 3054 lbs." under "Manual/PDK", with power-to-weight "8.5 / 8.7 lb./hp" for the Cayman S.
